in_sanskrit.name: Maniya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Jewel, Precious
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Maniya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Maniya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mani’ meaning ‘jewel’ or ‘gem’. This name is given to a girl who is believed to be as precious and valuable as a gem.
